title: MCTreeHole - An Anonymous Forum In-Game
description: An In-Game Anonymous Forum for Java Edition 1.21.6+. Users can publish anonymous threads, leave comments, or follow some of the threads.
body:
This is Leather Sword, a word full of features.

This pack is an example of an in-game anonymous forum (sometimes called a "Tree Hole") using dialog feature in 25w20a.
It supports Java Edition 1.21.6+.

Players are assigned a numeral forum ID when first logged in.
This ID is only for distinguishing players and would not appear in the chat pages.

With the ID, Players could publish blogs anonymously or comment under others' blogs.
They could also follow some blog pages for a later revision.

Note that you can send blogs with pictures, but it may require a redistribution of the server resource pack,
as you must load the picture in the form of font. (Loaded as character '0')
Otherwise, others may not be able to see the picture in the blog page.
That means, a player may need to upload the picture to the OP before using it in his/her blog thread.
